tasks.title: Establish project foundation
tasks.description: Create Python package layout, domain models, configuration, licensing, and developer documentation.
tasks.details: Standard-library-only runtime, typed dataclasses, per-user data paths, and safe defaults.
tasks.testStrategy: Import smoke tests and configuration unit tests.

tasks.title: Implement local persistence
tasks.description: Create SQLite schema and repositories for settings, seen executables, events, scan history, and quarantine records.
tasks.details: Use WAL, parameterized SQL, migrations, and one connection per operation/thread.
tasks.testStrategy: Temporary-database tests for migration, deduplication, baseline, events, and records.

tasks.title: Implement Windows native adapters
tasks.description: Wrap process, memory, CPU, network endpoint, Authenticode, elevation, and AMSI Windows APIs.
tasks.details: Use ctypes with explicit arg/restypes, deterministic handle cleanup, IPv4/IPv6 owner PID parsing, and graceful access-denied behavior.
tasks.testStrategy: Windows integration tests plus pure parser/error-path tests.

tasks.title: Implement explainable risk engine
tasks.description: Score process and file observations using conservative transparent signals.
tasks.details: Return bounded scores, severities, and human-readable evidence; distinguish unknown from untrusted.
tasks.testStrategy: Table-driven tests for system paths, temp executables, LOLBins, signatures, and threshold behavior.

tasks.title: Implement file scanner and quarantine
tasks.description: Add streaming SHA-256, signature/content/PE heuristics, optional AMSI, cancellation, recursive scanning, and explicit quarantine.
tasks.details: Never upload content or auto-delete; record complete evidence and recovery metadata.
tasks.testStrategy: Tests for clean files, EICAR construction, suspicious scripts, limits, cancellation, errors, and quarantine.

tasks.title: Implement process and network monitor
tasks.description: Coordinate snapshots, CPU deltas, executable identity baseline, unseen alerts, risk scoring, and endpoint ownership.
tasks.details: Use a bounded background polling loop and publish immutable snapshots/events to consumers.
tasks.testStrategy: Fake-adapter tests for first baseline, later unseen executable, changed metadata, process exits, and endpoint mapping.

tasks.title: Build desktop dashboard
tasks.description: Create responsive Overview, Processes, Network, Scanner, Alerts, and About views.
tasks.details: tkinter/ttk UI consumes services through thread-safe queues; include search/filter, evidence display, progress, cancellation, and explicit quarantine.
tasks.testStrategy: Controller tests and manual Windows UI smoke checklist.

tasks.title: Add diagnostic CLI
tasks.description: Provide JSON headless snapshot and file/folder scan commands for automation.
tasks.details: Stable exit codes and structured output; UI remains the default mode.
tasks.testStrategy: Subprocess smoke tests for help, snapshot JSON, clean scan, and detected test file.

tasks.title: Add packaging and CI
tasks.description: Create PyInstaller configuration, PowerShell release script, archive/checksum generation, and Windows CI.
tasks.details: Portable unsigned development artifact; document signing requirements and release credential gates.
tasks.testStrategy: Build executable, launch headless snapshot from dist, run test suite in CI.

tasks.title: Verify, harden, and document release
tasks.description: Run full tests, native integration checks, packaged smoke tests, security review checklist, and refresh project indexes.
tasks.details: Fix failures, document known limitations, update Task Master states, and produce v0.1 artifact/checksum.
tasks.testStrategy: All unit/integration tests pass and packaged CLI smoke returns valid JSON.

tasks.title: Integrate YARA-X detection
tasks.description: Add a pinned YARA-X 1.19.0 Python adapter, bundled rules, explainable match evidence, safe scan limits, and package collection.
tasks.details: Compile trusted local rules with includes disabled, scan bounded file bytes, expose rule id/metadata, and degrade visibly if the optional engine cannot initialize.
tasks.testStrategy: Rule compile, marker match, clean miss, malformed rules, timeout/error, scanner integration, and packaged import.

tasks.title: Add signed security-content updates
tasks.description: Implement Ed25519-authenticated manifests, SHA-256/size verification, HTTPS-only retrieval, atomic activation, version history, and rollback for YARA rules and local reputation data.
tasks.details: Canonical JSON signed with a pinned production public key; validate rules/feed before atomic switch and retain last-known-good content.
tasks.testStrategy: Valid update, bad signature, hash mismatch, insecure URL, invalid rules, interrupted activation, and rollback.

tasks.title: Add quarantine recovery and scan controls
tasks.description: Implement quarantine listing/restoration, hash allow-listing, path exclusions, and Quick/Full/Startup/Downloads scan profiles in core, CLI, and GUI.
tasks.details: Preserve explicit consent, collision-safe restores, canonical path matching, cancellation, and audit events.
tasks.testStrategy: Restore round trip, collision refusal, allow-list/exclusion behavior, profile resolution, CLI/UI controller tests.

tasks.title: Add DNS and local reputation enrichment
tasks.description: Resolve remote endpoint PTR names with bounded caching and classify local/public addresses against the signed local reputation feed.
tasks.details: PTR names are informational only; never treat DNS as identity. Avoid blocking monitor refresh and never upload network data.
tasks.testStrategy: Cache expiry, resolver failures, IP/CIDR match, private/loopback classification, and monitor integration.

tasks.title: Add ETW process events and WFP capability telemetry
tasks.description: Consume Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process ETW start/stop events with a polling fallback, and expose WFP engine/subscription capability state without installing a kernel driver.
tasks.details: Use documented ETW controller/consumer lifecycle and clean shutdown. Preserve polling where permissions/providers are unavailable; report WFP access precisely.
tasks.testStrategy: Fake event source, fallback paths, lifecycle cleanup, capability states, and live Windows diagnostic smoke.

tasks.title: Add background Windows service
tasks.description: Build an SCM-compatible OpenGuard Monitor service plus install/start/stop/status/uninstall CLI management and shared SQLite event history.
tasks.details: Use ServiceMain/control handler/status transitions, stop cleanly, quote ImagePath safely, and require elevation for mutations.
tasks.testStrategy: Service-host unit tests, command construction, packaged service dispatcher smoke, and elevated local install/status/start test.

tasks.title: Expand desktop and CLI v0.2 surfaces
tasks.description: Expose engine/update/service health, scan profiles, exclusions, allow-list, quarantine recovery, DNS/reputation, and event-source status.
tasks.details: Keep background work off the tkinter thread and preserve accessible confirmation flows for destructive actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Controller/format tests, CLI JSON contract tests, and Playwright-equivalent desktop screenshot/manual UI verification.

tasks.title: Harden, sign, release, and deploy v0.2
tasks.description: Update packaging/CI, add conditional Authenticode signing and verification, run full tests/security review, deploy locally, and publish an open-source GitHub release.
tasks.details: Sign all PE artifacts with SHA-256 and RFC3161 timestamps only when CA-issued credentials are present; never claim unsigned builds are production signed.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit/integration/UI/package/service smoke, artifact hashes, signature status check, clean secret scan, GitHub Actions/release verification.

tasks.title: Redesign desktop theme, scrollbars, navigation icons, and branding
tasks.description: Replace the blue-tinted desktop UI with a black/graphite visual system, custom dark scrollbars and window chrome, larger polished sidebar icons, and a generated OpenGuard logo used in-app and in packaged Windows executables.
tasks.details: Keep the existing Tkinter architecture and behavior. Add package-safe asset resolution, Windows dark title bar support with graceful fallback, ttk Notebook/Combobox/Treeview/Scrollbar styling, larger nav icon tiles, logo PNG and multi-size ICO, PyInstaller asset/icon flags, UI-focused tests, packaged visual verification, local redeployment, and app launch.
tasks.testStrategy: Run focused UI/theme unit tests and full suite, build PyInstaller release, verify PE icons/assets, launch packaged GUI, capture and inspect screenshots across pages and scrollable tables, then deploy locally.

tasks.title: Eliminate Security page UI freezes and add live per-process network usage
tasks.description: Move Security-page status/database/service work off the Tk thread and enrich network endpoints with actual TCP byte totals, live send/receive rates, and clearer destination context.
tasks.details: Profile the synchronous Security refresh, implement generation-safe background loading and cached rendering, preserve UI responsiveness under repeated navigation, add Windows TCP Extended Statistics via GetPerTcpConnectionEStats/SetPerTcpConnectionEStats with safe fallbacks, calculate rates from monotonic snapshot deltas, display sent/received totals and rates plus hostname/IP/reputation/direction, document UDP and encrypted-payload limitations, and avoid packet interception or TLS decryption claims.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit-test async Security refresh behavior and stale result handling, ctypes EStats parsing/fallbacks, counter delta/rate calculations and connection identity, run Windows integration/full suites, package, visually inspect Security and Network pages, deploy and reopen.

tasks.title: Migrate OpenGuard to a fully native scalable v0.3 architecture
tasks.description: Replace all Python production, test, packaging, and UI paths with a Rust native engine/service/CLI, C# WinUI desktop client, versioned authenticated local IPC, and new non-shield graphite branding while preserving and improving v0.2 behavior.
tasks.details: Architecture: Rust workspace for domain, persistence, detection, Windows telemetry, service and CLI; C# WinUI 3 MVVM desktop UI runs unprivileged; versioned length-prefixed JSON over ACL-restricted named pipes; service owns SQLite and privileged operations; C++/WDK reserved for separately signed minifilter/WFP drivers. Remove Python sources/dependencies only after parity tests. Produce self-contained Windows x64 artifacts, CI, docs, benchmarks, visual evidence, local install and release.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust and .NET unit tests, migration/contract tests, live Windows integration tests, service/IPC ACL tests, EICAR/YARA/AMSI tests, performance budgets, UI automation/screenshots, packaged smoke tests, installed hash verification, and zero-Python release audit.

subtasks.title: Lock native architecture and parity contract
subtasks.description: Document ADR, threat model, module boundaries, IPC security, performance budgets, migration order, and exhaustive v0.2 parity matrix.
subtasks.details: Architecture and acceptance criteria are reviewed against current Microsoft Windows App SDK, WDK, ETW, WFP, minifilter, named-pipe, and signing guidance.

subtasks.title: Build Rust workspace and shared foundations
subtasks.description: Implement versioned domain models, configuration, result/error semantics, strict IPC envelopes, storage ownership boundary, tracing, and cross-language schema fixtures.
subtasks.details: cargo fmt/clippy/test; schema golden tests; bounded decode/fuzz smoke; no unsafe code outside isolated Windows FFI modules.

subtasks.title: Port detection, storage, quarantine, updates and scan profiles
subtasks.description: Port SQLite migrations/repositories, hashing/heuristics, YARA-X, AMSI integration, signed content updates, exclusions, allow-list and recoverable quarantine.
subtasks.details: Parity/golden tests for every existing scanner/storage/update behavior plus cancellation, malformed input, races, and rollback.

subtasks.title: Port Windows monitoring and service
subtasks.description: Implement Rust Windows service, process/network collection, TCP EStats, DNS/reputation, Authenticode, ETW/WFP telemetry, event persistence, and ACL-restricted named-pipe server.
subtasks.details: Live Windows service tests, access-denied fallbacks, leak/soak tests, IPC authorization tests, and metric parity.

subtasks.title: Port CLI and management workflows
subtasks.description: Replace Python CLI with native Rust diagnostics, scan, quarantine, update, doctor and SCM management commands.
subtasks.details: JSON contract tests, exit-code tests, packaged CLI/service lifecycle smoke, and backwards-compatible command coverage.

subtasks.title: Create the new WinUI 3 UX
subtasks.description: Build a C# WinUI 3 MVVM app with responsive dashboard, process/network investigation, scanner, detections, quarantine and settings using virtualized data and background IPC.
subtasks.details: View-model tests, accessibility/keyboard checks, navigation latency budgets, repeated refresh stress, and automated screenshots for all primary views.

subtasks.title: Regenerate and integrate non-shield branding
subtasks.description: Generate a clean non-shield OpenGuard mark, derive deterministic PNG/ICO/MSIX assets, and apply a black/graphite design system throughout UI and packaging.
subtasks.details: Inspect source and rendered assets, validate alpha/icon sizes, check dark/light contrast policy, and visually verify installed executables and window chrome.

subtasks.title: Remove Python, harden, package, deploy and release
subtasks.description: Delete Python production/tests/build dependencies after parity, migrate CI/build/signing, run full security/performance/visual audits, deploy locally, open the app, and publish the native release.
subtasks.details: No .py/.pyw/pyproject/PyInstaller/runtime Python in source or artifacts; clean builds; hashes/signatures; tests and benchmarks pass; installed service/UI/CLI verified; GitHub CI/release green.

tasks.title: Stabilize live activity tables and add interactive telemetry graphs
tasks.description: Update WinUI process/network pages to reconcile live rows in place, preserve selection and scroll state, expose click-to-sort column headers, render bounded process and network activity histories, and provide safe process context actions.
tasks.details: Use keyed ObservableCollection reconciliation instead of Clear/repopulate; stable sort with explicit direction and default process CPU/network total activity; reusable native WinUI graph control; context actions include open file location, copy path/details, scan, and web search without termination or destructive operations; deploy updated native package.
tasks.testStrategy: Build WinUI with zero warnings, run Rust regression gates, exercise sort/filter/reconciliation and context commands, automate navigation and screenshots, smoke installed LocalSystem service and verify the deployed executable hash.

tasks.title: Eliminate process-table reranking churn and UI lag
tasks.description: Profile the recorded process-page refresh behavior, keep live values without continuously reranking rows, reduce UI-thread collection/render work, verify stable selection/scroll, and redeploy the optimized WinUI build.
tasks.details: Decouple live metric updates from explicit sorting; preserve deterministic membership and selection; coalesce graph redraws; measure refresh/navigation responsiveness against the installed service; retain manual click-to-sort behavior and accurate graph history.
tasks.testStrategy: Analyze recording frames, build WinUI with zero warnings, regression-test Rust service, automate process-list selection/scroll stability across repeated snapshots, measure UI CPU/responsiveness, capture installed screenshots, package and deploy.

tasks.title: Ship privileged investigation and behavioral protection milestone
tasks.description: Complete elevated deployment; add process investigation details, parent/child and persistence context, behavioral correlations, installer/signing hardening, adversarial validation, and publish the release.
tasks.details: Extend native snapshot/contracts/UI without regressing stable live tables; expose explainable non-destructive investigation evidence; validate false positives; produce an installer and signed artifacts when credentials exist; deploy and publish through authenticated existing tooling.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust unit/integration tests, C# Release build, UI Automation, package content and signature verification, elevated service/network/ETW smoke, adversarial fixtures, installer smoke, repository secret scan, GitHub release verification.

subtasks.title: Audit architecture and release prerequisites
subtasks.description: Inspect native/UI data flow, deployment state, GitHub auth, signing certificates, and installer tooling.

subtasks.title: Build process investigation experience
subtasks.description: Expose native process metadata and add an accessible WinUI investigation dialog/panel.

subtasks.title: Add behavioral correlation and persistence evidence
subtasks.description: Add explainable rules and startup persistence context with false-positive safeguards.

subtasks.title: Create hardened installer and signing gates
subtasks.description: Build MSI packaging, conditional Authenticode signing, and signature/package verification.

subtasks.title: Run adversarial and regression validation
subtasks.description: Run native, UI, installer, signature, and false-positive test suites.

subtasks.title: Deploy privileged release
subtasks.description: Install the service/helper with elevation and verify full process/network telemetry.

subtasks.title: Publish source and release
subtasks.description: Commit and push the milestone and publish verified artifacts through GitHub.

tasks.title: OpenGuard 0.5 real-time investigation and response
tasks.description: Deliver roadmap items 3, 4, 5, and 6: real-time file monitoring, expanded persistence detection, a historical investigation timeline, and safe user-confirmed response actions.
tasks.details: Use documented Windows user-mode APIs; bounded queues and explicit coverage; persist paginated evidence; audit all response actions; destructive actions require confirmation; temporary network controls must be scoped and reversible; build, test, package, and deploy.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust unit/integration tests, IPC contract tests, WinUI build and UI smoke checks, file watcher overflow/reconciliation tests, remediation authorization/audit tests, performance soak, installer verification.

subtasks.title: Real-time file monitoring
subtasks.description: Add bounded ReadDirectoryChangesW watchers, USN journal checkpoints, overflow reconciliation, telemetry coverage, and tests.

subtasks.title: Expanded persistence inventory
subtasks.description: Inventory services/drivers, scheduled tasks, WMI permanent consumers, and browser extensions with explicit coverage and findings.

subtasks.title: Historical investigation timeline
subtasks.description: Persist normalized timeline evidence and expose owner-scoped, filtered, cursor-paginated IPC/UI queries.

subtasks.title: Confirmed response actions
subtasks.description: Add authenticated user-confirmed terminate/quarantine/temporary network block and reversible persistence-disable actions with audit records.

subtasks.title: WinUI investigation surfaces
subtasks.description: Add timeline and persistence UI, response confirmation dialogs, progress/error states, and coverage messaging.

subtasks.title: Verification, packaging, and deployment
subtasks.description: Run focused/full tests, Clippy, WinUI release build, performance smoke, package verification, install, and live smoke.
